commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a weak score of 44 and benchmark indices succumbing to intense distribution, William O’Neil’s cardinal rule takes center stage: three out of four stocks inevitably follow the market's trend. The sharp breach of key index supports driven by crude spikes and relentless FII liquidations signals severe institutional de-risking. Stan Weinstein’s stage framework warns that Stage 2 breakouts face elevated failure rates in a declining tape. Under Mark Minervini’s progressive exposure discipline, capital preservation is paramount. New risk must be strictly curtailed, stop-losses kept deterministic, and cash preserved until index accumulation days confirm a genuine market bottom and relative strength leaders decouple sustainably.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Discipline

AAATECH.technical: Price cleared the 20-session high on massive 10.93× volume with RSI at 64. However, the breakout emerges from an immature Stage 1 base lacking a defined multi-contraction VCP. Relative strength remains nascent during broad market distribution.
AAATECH.fundamental: AAA Technologies is virtually debt-free, but revenue growth of +3.2% and ROE of 6.7% fall well below CANSLIM standards. Low promoter holding of 34.4% and stretching working capital days limit institutional sponsorship interest.
AAATECH.risk: Thesis fails if price slips back below the breakout level; enforce the deterministic stop at 91.81.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price trades above key averages in a 26.6% deep double-bottom base with a 5.7% handle. However, overhead supply remains heavy and the setup lacks institutional volume conviction amidst deteriorating general market conditions.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational contraction disqualifies the setup under CANSLIM. Q1 FY27 sales dropped 56.3% and profit contracted 25.6% YoY. TTM ROE sits near a dismal 3.1%, while high multiples reflect speculative rather than institutional interest.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Pattern fails if handle support disintegrates below 95.61; cut losses immediately.

ACE.technical: Classic Stage 2 uptrend above rising 50-day and 200-day moving averages. An orderly 12.8% cup with a tight 4.4% handle forms an actionable pivot, exhibiting quiet volume on pullbacks and resilient relative strength.
ACE.fundamental: Driven by infrastructure capex, Q1 FY27 revenue expanded +18.9% and PAT grew +22.3% YoY. Operating margins held steady at 14.9%, backed by high ROCE (>20%) and negligible net debt, fulfilling core CANSLIM criteria.
ACE.risk: Setup invalidates if price breaks below handle support; honor the stop strictly at 1189.87.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Double-bottom base holding above rising 21-day EMA and major moving averages. RSI at 61 reflects constructive accumulation without extension, showing solid relative strength as institutional money seeks defensive utility and energy plays.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Explosive Q1 FY27 performance with revenue up +67.8% and EPS jumping +71.8% YoY, bolstered by rapid battery energy storage (BESS) expansion and 87% EBITDA margins. High leverage is partially alleviated by recent QIP proceeds.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Breakout fails if price undercuts double bottom support; cut exposure at 436.83.

ADVANCE.technical: Tight consolidation within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on double average volume. Moving averages are aligned in Stage 2 sequence and RSI at 57 reflects controlled pressure inside an emerging Darvas box.
ADVANCE.fundamental: Exceptional CANSLIM credentials with revenue surging +95.9% and net profit leaping +152.2% in Q1 FY27. Return on capital is strong with ROCE at 19.6% and ROE at 17.2%, though working capital requires ongoing monitoring.
ADVANCE.risk: Thesis collapses if price violates the consolidation shelf; respect the stop at 130.78.

AETHER.technical: High-powered SEPA breakout to a fresh 52-week high on 8.13× average volume despite severe market distribution. All key moving averages are in textbook bullish alignment, demonstrating premier relative-strength leadership.
AETHER.fundamental: Strong contract manufacturing demand boosted Q1 FY27 revenue by +27.3% and profit by +33.5% YoY, maintaining industry-leading ~30% EBITDA margins. Debt-to-equity is minimal at 0.14 with zero promoter share pledging.
AETHER.risk: Breakout thesis fails on a reversal back into the prior range; exit below 1596.97.
